solves.reason: 원문: ancient art / Two separate classes / trained yoga instructor → ① ancient—separate—trained
원문: inner strength / beginner class / free after 5:00 pm → ③ inner—beginner—free
원문: surrounded by fossils / intermediate / participation agreement → ② surrounded—intermediate—participation
② identical → 원문은 separate. Two identical classes는 문맥상 부적절
④ costly → 원문은 free. Parking is costly는 문맥상 부적절
③ excluded → 원문은 provided. 'they are not excluded'는 원문 'they are not provided'와 다름
the ____ art of yoga → 원문 ancient. recent/popular/traditional 중 ancient가 정확

sign a participation ____ → agreement. 참가 동의서

separate ≈ individual (별도의 ≈ 개별적인)
contact ≈ reach (연락하다)
beginner ↔ expert (초보자 ↔ 전문가)
inner ↔ external (내면의 ↔ 외부의)
(A) We practice = 연습하다(동사). (B) common practice = 관행(명사). ③ 연습하다—관행

a ____ (participate) agreement: 명사 위치 → participation
a ____ (train) yoga instructor: 형용사/과거분사 위치 → trained
